title: Implement effective potential ground-state solver
action: Implement a numerical solver for the ground state of the generalized FK model (model 1) using the effective potential eigenvalue method. For given parameters D=0.5, epsilon=0.1, misfit gamma, and strength K, find the periodic ground-state configuration {u_i}, period Q, and atomic positions. The solver must handle periods Q<=5. Write a small proof-of-run log file solver_log.txt showing convergence for a few test points.
description: Process step that implements the core ground-state solver for model 1.

title: Compute ω, Ω, and symmetry for model 1 at D=0.5
action: For model 1 with D=0.5, ε=0.1, compute ground states at the (K,γ) points listed in the instruction. For each point, compute winding number ω (fraction P/Q), rotation number Ω (fraction), and symmetry type (A if no atom sits at a top of V(x), B otherwise). Output a CSV file model1_D0.5_results.csv with columns: K (float), gamma (float), omega (string), Omega (string), symmetry_type (string 'A' or 'B').
description: Scored pointwise results for model 1 D=0.5; includes both published and hidden points.
output_schema: CSV with header: K, gamma, omega, Omega, symmetry_type. All columns as string except K/gamma floats.

title: Generate phase diagram for model 1 D=0.5
action: Scan a grid of γ∈[0,1] and K∈[0,2] (200×200 points). For each point, compute the ground state using the solver (model 1, D=0.5, ε=0.1) and determine Ω and symmetry type. Plot a phase diagram: γ on the x-axis, K on the y-axis, each point coloured by Ω, with visible markers for A/B regions. Save as phase_diagram.png.
description: Phase diagram image for model 1 D=0.5; structural audit.
output_schema: PNG image with labelled axes, colour-coded by Ω, A/B regions distinguishable.
